## What does this change improve?

Explain the need in plain language. Link the community report or other issue
(for example, `Closes #123`).

## Evidence

Link the publisher page, public documentation, or other evidence used. State
what is still uncertain. Do not include private or restricted information.

## What changed?

List the files or records changed and the effect users will see.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I linked the issue or explained why there is no issue.
- [ ] I kept stable IDs and recorded the source of the information.
- [ ] I separated publisher statements, steward judgments, and automated observations.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, private data, signed links, or source files we cannot share.
- [ ] I checked community-facing wording for plain language and accessibility.
- [ ] I described important limits, uncertainty, and effects on interpretation.

When the change includes code, schemas, monitoring, or copied/transformed data:

- [ ] I ran and listed the relevant tests below.
- [ ] I documented licensing and credit for copied or transformed data.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I checked whether the change needs two reviewers under `GOVERNANCE.md`.

## Checks run

List checks and results, or write “Not applicable — community documentation
only.”
